line.name: United
line.description: United Cigars' own-name flagship house blend - a genuinely separate blend from 'Independence' (Independence uses Mexican Habano wrapper/Dominican binder/Dominican+Nicaraguan ligero filler; United uses Ecuadorian Habano or Mexican San Andrés wrapper over Dominican binder/filler). Produced at Tabacalera Magia, Dominican Republic. Currently sold in a box-pressed-to-'Round' production format.
line.wrapper: Natural/Connecticut: Ecuadorian Habano (marketed as 'Sun Grown'); Maduro: Mexican San Andrés
line.filler: Dominican Broadleaf, Quisqueya, Dominican Seco, Dominican Olor
line.strength: Natural/Connecticut: mild-medium; Sun Grown/Habano: medium; Maduro: full-bodied

research_notes: 'Round' is United's current box-pressed-to-round production format, not a distinct sub-brand - Round-Robusto/Toro/Churchill photos map to the same Robusto/Toro/Churchill vitolas above. 'Pencil' is a genuine separate United sub-shape (6x28 thin panetela), confirmed via LM Cigars and Cigar Century, available Natural and Maduro. Sleeve-pack photos (Pack-CT/Mad/SG-Sleeve) appear to be Toro-sized per '2 Guys Cigars' United Bag Toro product naming, but exact vitola within the sleeve wasn't independently confirmed - flagged, not asserted as fact. This is NOT the same product as 'Independence' (already listed on the site) - do not merge.
